question: True or false: using a full-stack React framework means you must deploy your app to a server.
say: True or false? Using a full stack React framework means you must deploy your app to a server.
explanation: The recommended frameworks support client rendering, single-page apps and static generation, which can be deployed to a CDN or static hosting without a server.
explainSay: False. They also support client only and static apps that you can host without a server.
